translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

content: Isaraele wali agali garabaya howa golalu Yarusaleme dai binigo ogo

Isaraele wali agali dewaore Babilono dindi yu wahalu tini dalu Yarusalemehabi Yuda dindi maru wiaruhabi hole dai bini. Bambaore Kini Nebugadanesa heangi ibugua wai bialu Yuda wali agali garabaya bu yalu Babilono penego ogoniha ti haabo hene.

Yudali agali haguane minu yalu penedaruni maru Serubabele Yosua Nehemaia imaru Seraia Lelaia Modegai imaru Bilisana Misiba Bigibai imaru Lehumu Bana imaru pu hene. Ani howa Isaraele wali agali garabaya pu henego golalu Yarusaleme dai biniru hameigini mbira mbiranaga daga ogodagua.

Paroso aria daosini kirani handari mbirani pira kariani kira (2,172) hene. Sebadia aria handari tebirani pira kariani kira (372) hene. Ara aria handari kariani pira kariani duria (775) hene. Yasua Yoabala aguanene Pahadamoaba aria daosini kirani handari halirani pira mbirani kira (2,812) hene. Elama aria daosini mbirani handari kirani pira duriani maria (1,254) hene. Sadu aria handari dirani pira mariani duria (945) hene. Sagai aria handari kariani pira waragaria (760) hene. Bani aria handari waragariani pira mariani kira (642) hene. Bebai aria handari waragariani pira kirani tebira (623) hene. Asagada aria daosini mbirani handari kirani pira kirani kira (1,222) hene. Adonigama aria handari waragariani pira waragariani waragaria (666) hene. Bigibai aria daosini kirani pira duriani waragaria (2,056) hene. Adini aria handari mariani pira duriani maria (454) hene. Ade (ibu mini mende Hesegaia) aria pira dirani halira (98) hene. Besai aria handari tebirani pira kirani tebira (323) hene. Yora aria handari mbirani pira mbirani kira (112) hene. Hasama aria handari kirani pira kirani tebira (223) hene. Giba aria pira dirani duria (95) hene.

Yuda wali agali o dai biyadaruni tinaga mamalinaga tano mini uru wigi binigoha dai bialu haga haga bini. Bedelehemeha handari mbirani pira kirani tebira (123). Nedobaha pira duriani waragaria (56). Anadodoha handari mbirani pira kirani halira (128). Asamabedeha pira mariani kira (42). Kiriada Yarimihabi Kebirahabi Berodohabi handari kariani pira mariani tebira (743). Lamahabi Gebahabi handari waragariani pira kirani mbira (621). Migimasaha handari mbirani pira kirani kira (122). Bedelehabi Aihabi handari kirani pira kirani tebira (223). Nebeha pira duriani kira (52). Magabisiha handari mbirani pira duriani waragaria (156). Elama mendeha daosini mbirani handari kirani pira duriani maria (1,254). Harimiha handari tebirani pira kira (320). Lodohabi Hadidihabi Onohabi handari kariani pira kirani duria (725). Yarigoha handari tebirani pira mariani duria (345). Senaha daosini tebirani handari waragariani pira tebira (3,630). Tano uruniha ti daibu haga haga bini.

Loma binigo mo miaga agali Yarusalemeni daibu henedaru tinaga minibi dagabi ogodagua. Yasua aguane Yadaia aria handari dirani pira kariani tebira (973) hene. Ime aria daosini mbirani pira duriani kira (1,052) hene. Pasahuru aria daosini mbirani handari kirani pira mariani karia (1,247) hene. Harimi aria daosini mbirani pira mbirani karia (1,017) hene.

Libai hameigini Yarusaleme daibu heneru minibi dagabi ogodagua Hodabia aguane Yasua Kadamielela aria pira kariani maria (74) hene. Anduane Homogonaga andaha iba gana laga biaga heneru Asaba aria handari mbirani pira kirani halira (128) hene. Anduane Homogonaga andaha mamage haga heneru Salumu ariabi Ade ariabi Talamono ariabi Agubu ariabi Hadida ariabi Sobai ariabi handari mbirani pira tebirani dira (139) hene.

Garabaya howa golalu dai binidaruni Anduane Homogonaga andaha biabe bialu haga agali urunaga aguane dai binigo uru. Siha Hasuba Tabaodo Keroso Siaha Padono Lebana Hagabaha Agubu Hagaba Samalai Hanana Gidele Gaha Leaia Lesini Negoda Gasama Usa Pasea Besai Asana Meunimi Nebisimi Bagabugu Haguba Hahu Basaludu Mehida Harasa Bagoso Sisera Tema Nesia Hadiba uruni aguaneneru daibu ha dege bini.

Solomononaga biabe biahaga aria henerunaga aguanene garabaya golalu tini daluha daibu henedaru uru. Sodai Hasoberede Peruda Yala Dagono Gidele Sebadia Hadili Pogerede Hasebaimi Amila uruni aguaneneru haga bini.

Anduane Homogonaga andaha agali biabe biaga aguanene henerubi Solomononaga biabe biahaga aguanene henerubi bibahende garabaya golalu dai buwa henego dagalamaga howa handari tebirani pira dirani kira (392) tini daluni dai bu hene.

Ani howa Delaia hameigini Tobia hameigini Negoda hameiginiru ti bibahende dagalamaga halu handari waragariani pira duriani kira (652) hene. Ti bibahende Telemela tanohabi Teleharasa tanohabi Kerubu tanohabi Adana tanohabi Ime tanohabi tano uruniha howa daibu hene. Ani daibu howa agali hameigini uruni ti tininaga mamali hama ibinigo Isaraele hameigini henedaru aria mbirago mini labe nahe howa ti Isaraele aria kamabe tara kamabe toba howa dege hene.

Loma binigo mo miaga agali maru heneru tigua ti mamalirunaga mini mbugaha agua ngabe hondole tai bialu hearia tinaga minigo mbira wiaria handa walia nahe dege hene. Agali mini taibu wahenedaru tinaga mini uru. Hobaiabi Hagosobi Basilai imaru hene.
Loma binigo mo miaga agali uruni tinaga mamali heneru mini nawiyago hondowa agali haguane henerume ti loma binigo mo miaga nahelo lene.

Ani heagola Yuda agali gabumane agali haguane heagome lalu, Agali uruni ti wali agalime Anduane Homogohondo tomo lomabu mini ngaru nanelo, lalu bi lowini. Agali haguane ogoni ibugua lalu, Loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane mbira íbu kangi ibugua Anduane Homogonaga hame ngago hale hole halaga biaga ege to̱le̱ kira mini Urimu Tumimula ngagoha howa hale helo. Ani hale howa ibugua agali uruni tigua loma binigo mo miaga holene nga layagua nde tigua biabe ogoni bialu helo. Ai nabilo layagua nde wahelo, lene.

Isaraele wali agali garabaya golalu dai binidaruni bibahende daga lamaga halu daosini dege pira mariani kira halu handari tebirani pira waragaria (42,360) tini daluni daibu hene. Tinaga biabe biahaga wali agali bibahende daosini dege kariani handari tebirani pira tebirani karia (7,337) haru halu dai bini. Wali agali iba ganaru lalu ngida balu piliperu pulalu biaga handari kira (200) bibahende daibu hene. Tinaga nogo hosi handari kariani pira tebirani waragaria (736) haru halu ibini. Nogo hosi dongilame igini hono winiru mini muele laga handari kirani pira mariani duria (245) haru halu ibini. Nogo kamele handari mariani pira tebirani duria (435) haru halu ibini. Nogo dongi daosini dege waragariani handari kariani pira kira (6,720) haru dai bialu ibini.

Ani ibalu Yarusalemeni Anduane Homogonaga anda heagoria anda ibugu bialu howa tini hameigini ibugu biyadagua agali haguane mbira mbirame Anduane Homogonaga anda biago biadai bilonaga turu halu munibi mbirale marubi bame migi bini. Tigua Anduane Homogonaga anda ogoni abale hene biagoria dege biadai bulene manda buwa ani bini.

Ani mialu howa mbirale dewa yu hearume dewa mialu emene yu hearume emene migi bini. Isaraele wali agalime anda ogoni bilonaga ngolo genda magi kilogarama handari duria (500) mialu muni siliba genda magi kilogarama daosini dege kirani handari halira (2,800) mo mogobu mini. Ani mialu loma binigo mo miaga agalime aga karulagane handari mbira (100) mo mialu bini.

Ani bialu Libai hameigini loma binigo mo miaga bu hearubi wali agali marubi ti Yarusalemeha anda ibalu maru tano ogoniha hene. Ti maru emene kawareha pu hene. Wali agali iba ganaru lalu ngida balu pilipe pulalu biaga hearubi mamage haga agali hearubi Anduane Homogonaga andaha biabe biaga hearubi ti bibahende Yarusaleme tano kaware wiaruha haga haga bini. Ani heagola Isaraele wali agali maru ti nde tininaga tano wiyaruha hama pugu pugu bini.
